annotations.title: Look up a Facebook video ad

description: Check how old a Facebook video ad really is and which stores run the same video. Input: a Meta Ad Library link or ad ID, or a SpyWinAds video_id (from spywin_list_my_videos, spywin_get_scan_results or other tools). Returns the day the video file was first uploaded to Facebook (accurate to 1-2 days), the first ad date, live ads, how many stores run the same video now and ever, and the earliest stores in the SpyWinAds library.

ad.description: Meta Ad Library link (https://www.facebook.com/ads/library/?id=...) or the numeric ad ID
